sv.title: Tänk om Jensen Huang hette Mette, tjej i skinnpaj
sv.summary: Huang lyckas inte hålla gylfen stängd – och världens börser rasar. Men Donald Trump ser en chans att tjäna pengar.

en.title: Imagine if Jensen Huang were called Mette, a girl in a leather pie
en.summary: Huang fails to keep his zipper closed – and the world's stock markets plunge. But Donald Trump sees a chance to make money.
